summary: Phase 2G.3 Emergency Contacts CRUD API testing completed successfully. All 31 core tests passed. Emergency contacts can be managed via API with proper role-based access control. Phone normalization and duplicate detection working correctly. Regression tests confirm existing features (crash events, push notifications, notification logs) still work properly.
passed_tests: All 7 demo users can log in successfully
GET /api/emergency-contacts - fleet_admin and super_admin can list contacts
POST /api/emergency-contacts - fleet_admin and super_admin can create contacts
Phone normalization works correctly - all formats (XXX-XXX-XXXX, (XXX) XXX-XXXX, XXXXXXXXXX, +1XXXXXXXXXX) normalize to E.164
Duplicate detection works - different phone formats trigger 409 conflict
PUT /api/emergency-contacts/{id} - returns 409 when trying to use another contact's phone
Regression: POST /api/crash-events still works with zero DB contacts (fallback to env NOTIFY_CRASH_CONTACTS)
